package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
)

// scenario for bytes_buffer_truncate_zero_reset: `buf.Truncate(0)` instead of `buf.Reset()`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario447Positive(data []byte) *bytes.Buffer {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	buf.Write(data)
	buf.Truncate(0)
	buf.Write(data)
	return &buf
}
